fingerprints.reason: Deliberate design: a change the person asks for runs at once and its effect is reported. Confirmation is kept where it matters: a spend of at least half the remaining credits, deletes and sharing outside AIReady return a proposal the person must approve first.

Plain text the scanner cannot fully read, not hidden content: a bounded static parser stops early in a regex-heavy helper script, or flags a dense reference table as obfuscated text. Rewrites of the reported lines did not clear it (2026-11). The files are in this public repository for review.
